meta.tagline: The pipeline that turns raw data into tensors
meta.description: High-performance C++20 data loading library for AI — Source → Dataset → Sampler → DataLoader → Batch → NDArray.

status.illustrative: Illustrative sample data, not real results

home.title: MatrixData
home.subtitle: The pipeline that turns raw data into tensors
home.lede: NexusData is a C++20 library that reads files, splits and shuffles rows, and hands your training loop batches of NDArray tensors.
home.useTrain: Training loops — CSV, JSON, and image folders into seeded, reproducible batches.
home.useTabular: Tabular work — headers, missing values, clip, log1p, standardize, min-max.
home.useMedia: Images — JPEG, PNG, BMP, TGA, and GIF, with resize, crop, flip, and normalize.
home.statusNote: Library and docs site are under active development. Feature badges reflect honest status.
home.pipeline: Source → Dataset → Sampler → DataLoader → Batch → NDArray
home.privacyNote: Country headers are used only for one-shot language choice and are never stored, logged, or sent to analytics.

loader.hint: Press Esc or S to skip

sources.title: Read every format
sources.body: CSVDataset, JsonDataset, and ImageFolder are in the default build. Parquet, SQLite, and HDF5 compile only when those libraries are enabled in CMake.

shuffle.title: Dataset, shuffle & seed
shuffle.body: The Sampler shuffles indices — the Dataset is never mutated. Same seed restores the exact order.
shuffle.note: This visualization mimics a reference PCG32 Fisher–Yates. It stays illustrative until verified against C++ golden values.

batch.title: Batch & DataLoader
batch.body: Indices pass a DataLoader gate in batch_size groups. Toggle drop_last to drop or keep the final incomplete batch.

gpu.title: Prefetch & GPU
gpu.body: While batch N is consumed, N+1 can prepare on another buffer. GPU is used only for data prep that wins — decode, resize, normalize, collate.
gpu.policy: GPU is used only where it wins; otherwise it stays off.
gpu.chartEmpty: CPU/GPU crossover chart: not measured yet. Real curves will load from data/benchmarks/*.json.

ecosystem.title: Delivered as tensors
ecosystem.body: Batches become NDArray/tensor payloads for consumers. MatrixData is the data plane — computation libraries remain separate and optional.

features.title: Capabilities
features.body: Honest status badges — nothing is marked ready before it ships.

determinism.title: Determinism
determinism.body: Same seed, same order — independent of thread count once verified.

zerocopy.title: Zero-copy views
zerocopy.body: Subsets and reshapes share memory when safe.

formats.title: Many formats
formats.body: Readers grow behind a stable Dataset interface.

gpu.title: Optional GPU
gpu.body: CUDA backend for prep kernels — CPU path always works.

performance.title: Measured on this machine
performance.body: Release build, 23 Sep 2026, Ryzen 7 5800H. Bars compare NexusData’s own scalar loops with the AVX2 kernels. They are not other libraries.
